title: Integrative multi-omics analysis identifies methylation-associated lncRNAs FAM83A-AS2 and AC012213.1 as candidate prognostic markers in lung adenocarcinoma

evidence_spans.quote: By integrating RNA-seq and Illumina 450K methylation data from 473 LUAD and 32 normal lung samples in TCGA, we identified
Cox models (adjusted for age, sex, and tumor stage)

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: Empirical analysis of lung-cancer molecular data; age is only an adjustment covariate, with no analyzed aging construct.

causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Spearman methylation-expression associations; Cox-model survival associations
